title: Friend, Do What You Came For

request.style: English, female voice, solo with subtle choir, piano, cello, acoustic guitar, light percussion, somber and reflective, 70 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Twelve names written down in the book
Simon, James, and John, and the crowd
Philip and Bartholomew, Thomas too
Matthew the tax collector, the view
James of Alphaeus, Thaddaeus stands
Simon the Cananaean, in the hands
And Judas Iscariot, last in the list
The one who betrayed him, missing the gift

[Chorus]
Friend, do what you came for
They laid their hands on him
The kiss on his face
Was the very last grace

[Verse]
He kept the money box in his hand
Took what was put in, not as planned
Said why sell perfume for the poor
Three hundred denarii, that is the score
But he did not care for the needy
He was a thief, as the text is ready
Went to the chief priests with a plan
Asked what they would give him for the man

[Chorus]
Friend, do what you came for
They laid their hands on him
The kiss on his face
Was the very last grace

[Verse]
Thirty pieces of silver paid
He watched for a time, to be weighed
In the garden, a crowd with swords
Arrived with clubs, among the lords
He gave them a sign to find
The one I kiss, you will find
He went straight up and kissed his face
Greetings, Rabbi, in that place

[Chorus]
Friend, do what you came for
They laid their hands on him
The kiss on his face
Was the very last grace

[Bridge]
Seeing Jesus condemned in the court
Seized with remorse, torn apart
Brought back the silver to the priests
I sinned, I betrayed innocent beasts
They said, What is that to us
See to it yourself, do as you must
He flung the silver in the temple ground
And left the crowd, in the silence found

[Outro]
He went away and hanged himself
The end of the betrayal, no self
